messages: Apparently, there's someone in #m10003000# by the name of #p407# that stands on top of a building just staring at the sky, 24/7.

I went to meet #b#p407##k on top of a building in #m10003000#. He was a nice guy with an unquenchable thirst for flying. He's trying to fulfill his lifelong dream of flying by building a hang glider. He asked if I'd gather up the materials for it, and I couldn't reject his sincere desire to fly, even though this whole endeavor seems dubious at best. I'll need to get him #b30 #t4000017#s#k, #b10 #t4003001#s#k, and #b15 #t4003002#s#k.

I got the materials #p407# needed to make the hang glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge wings are enough to make the hang glider fly... I don't really know if this will work, but who knows, he could end up succeeding. I should check up on him when he's done building it.
name: Icarus's Hang Glider
